takeaways: Revenue jumped 43.4% to about $8.6 billion, well above the $8.045 billion estimate (Benzinga).
EPS of $0.78 missed: Benzinga had $0.81 and StreetInsider $0.99, so the size of the miss depends on whose consensus you use.
Shopee revenue rose 41.3% to $6.1 billion on 4.5 billion orders; Shopee adjusted EBITDA rose 44.7% to $269.2 million.
Monee (the lending arm) grew revenue 63.9% to $1.6 billion, with loans outstanding up 60% to $12.6 billion and 90-day bad loans at 1.3% vs 1.1% a year ago.
Garena bookings rose 5.9% to $890 million on Free Fire.
verdict: Sea sold a ton more stuff, lent a ton more money, and still came up a few cents short on profit. Wall Street wanted growth AND margins; Sea delivered growth and a slightly bigger bad-loan pile. Not a disaster, just not the clean sweep a stock down this much needed.
